# A group that starts closed

Valid.

The table draws two sections. "calc.ops" (summary "1 function") is open and shows `add()`.
"calc.tests" (summary "2 test helpers, all folded") starts closed: the reader shows its header
only. When the reader opens it, its two rows are minor, so they sit behind one control,
"Show 2 more", until that is clicked too. If the reader selects `fixture()`, for example from
the element panel, the section opens and that row shows.
